Review: i read the reviews and was kind of nervous about spending the money for something i had never heard of! i hate stuff that leaves my hair feeling dirty or heavy! i'm so glad i took the leap! i made my mom try it (who never does anything with her hair) and it made her hair so much healthier looking... and brought the curls out so nicely! my niece, who is mixed, tried it... and she loved it as well! so pretty much... it doesn't matter how curly your hair is, or what nationality you are... try this! no regrets!

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: not bad
Review: i didn't dislike this product, i'm just finding that i don't like this kind of consistency much. i've tried other custards and a flaxseed gel with the same consistency and it just isn't my thing. i have fine hair, and used this at the beginning of my cg transistion, so it was kind of a 2a-2b wave. the product was nice for a wash-and-wear, one product look. it also smells like sprite to me, which is a pleasant and not over powering smell. unlike some custards, it didn't make my hair look stringy if i used a little too much. i gave what i had left to a friend with coarser, 3b-3c hair and she likes it as a wash-and-wear as well.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: great moisture without the weight
Review: i chose this light conditioner to try out on my daughters fine, straight hair, and also wanted something lighter for my fine 2b waves. i really like it for both of our hair. it actually leaves my daughter's fine hair kind of plumped. if you leave it in awhile, it deeply moisturizes and feels almost like buttery smooth. yet still is so light, unlike butters and oils that weigh hair down.  it's keeping my 2b waves much more bouncy as oppose to some of the heavier butter like cowashing i did in the past.  i plan to use this for my daily conditioner.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: tainted product!
Review: do not order this from amazon!!!can't believe after removing the outside plastic seal, this is what the inner seal looked like. it is dissolving. the section missing from the lid was down inside the product. i went to remove it and it disintegrated. gone! returning and only ordering from moptop direct. this is not going on my hair!!

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: allergenic?
Review: i have never had an allergy to anything, except to something in this cowash. my scalp was covered in blisters. aside from the reaction, i didn’t find this to be cleansing at all and my hair looked greasier after using this cowash than it did prior to washing. smells nice though.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: rinses well
Review: i appreciate the value of this product in terms of quantity and quality which definitely justifies its price. i chose this because it was recommended by the cgm website for those with long 2a hair. it rinses well where i do not have to stand long in the shower just to rinse it off. it makes my hair really shiny without being weighed down. i wish this came in a bigger bottle with a pump.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: i didn't think i had waves! i do!
Review: i went for a perm, but my stylist talked me or of it-she said i had volume and waves, i just needed the right cut and products. she added some layers and sold me some shampoo, and i bought some mop top, after reading reviews. after about a month of using this product, plus avoiding straightening, i actually have a head full of bouncy waves! the scent dries fresh and mild, it doesn't leave hair crunchy, and it spreads lightly and evenly.  i recommend trying it, and i will be purchasing more!

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: do not buy
Review: this product leaves your hair looking disgusting. it flakes like crazy, which makes no sense because it’s for curly hair so it should be scrunchable. not even close, don’t waste your money.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: excellent product for defining curls!
Review: this is my first experience with moptop. i’m a loyal deva curl user for many years but my curly hair is getting looser the older i get, and a good product is needed more than ever to alleviate frizz and define curl. the smell is a mild citrus, very tolerable, and the texture appears water soluble and blended well into my damp hair. no residue and dried slightly crisp which i could somewhat shake out. however i prefer a stronger hold, especially as the day wears on in humidity. the key is to leave your hair alone when you apply product and that’s always a challenge. with deva, i combine several different products to get good hold. this one does it all by itself. i’m very pleased so far.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: no slip
Review: i purchased bc a cgm youtuber said this conditioner had great slip - absolutely not! no slip at all, didn’t help with tangles at all.also - less of a big deal- i had to squeeze package so hard that i creased the packaging. this is with the bottle full of product.  i cannot imagine how difficult it would have been later.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: amazing!
Review: i rarely write product reviews, but this sh*t is amazing. the internet made me buy it—specifically, the real life curly girl on youtube. i have wavy (2b if you follow curly girl method) hair that is long, medium density, medium thickness, and pretty porous (colored). this product is not heavy, is not crunchy, and provides some volume with zero frizz. it can be used on its own for curl and medium hold or under a gel as just a curl activator. new holy grail—i keep trying other things, and they don’t come close. i was not paid for this review.

Product: ﻿MopTop Gentle Shampoo, Natural Hair Moisturizer, Reduces Frizz, Color Safe Volumizing Shampoo - For All Hair Types, Straight, Curly, Wavy, Thin, Coily (8 oz)
Title: great stuff and smells good
Review: my fine 2b curls loved this stuff! plus it didn’t weigh my hair down which is always my biggest issue. i used it with the curly custard by mop top. great combo for nice hold and hydration!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: perfect for fine hair.
Review: i used the deva curl gel for a few years, until it completely dried out my hair. that is when i discovered that i have low porosity hair, and that the deva curl gel is full of protein, which is not good for low porosity hair so, i went looking for something with minimal protein and found the mop top curly hair custard. i wasn't expecting much, because there are no curl holding chemicals in this gel, but i was very surprised to see that my hair was both fluffy and curly after just one little scoop (3 fingers) of gel. with mop top, less is more, so you don't need much. to refresh second day curls, just put a dash of gel and leave in conditioner in a small spray bottle with water. spray and scrunch, and your curls will hold another day or two, even on fine hair. what i like the most is that this product never weighs down your hair. and it smells citrusy, which i like a lot.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i love this shampoo!
Review: i started the curly/wavy girl method and tried several "low-poos", but they were too watery and didn't cleanse my hair. then i tried a moptop sample kit and loved this shampoo and conditioner. the shampoo has the perfect consistency - not too thick but not too watery. for a low-poo it sudses up amazingly, and is easy to scrub into my scalp. i can tell it doesn't cleanse my scalp as well as my clarifying shampoo, but that is to be expected. i will use it 3 out of 4 washes to encourage the natural oils in my hair. it has a great balance of protein vs. moisture. and best of all is the scent - i didn't know bamboo could smell so good! it is an addicting sweet/fresh scent that makes me really look forward to wash days. which says a lot, as i am usually very sensitive to fragrances and there are many hair products i have to toss because the scents really bother me. i'm loving my journey with moptop!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: keeping hair nice and soft, gentle shampoo
Review: i got this because i was going to try out the curly girl method, which i found out isn’t for me but i still like this shampoo. i try to not wash my hair every day but i live in florida, and exercise most days so i feel like to feel fresh i do need to wash my hair almost daily, and this shampoo doesn’t dry it out. i use a minuscule amount, spread around in my hands and just wash roots. works well for my mid length dry at ends but easily greasy roots - hair 👌🏼

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: a great conditioner
Review: i started the curly girl method and heard a youtuber rave about moptop. i tried the sample pack and instantly fell in love. the shampoo and conditioner are very moisturizing while containing a good balance of protein. the consistency is perfect - not too thick but not too watery. the conditioner provides just the right amount of "slick" feel and makes my hair easy to brush. my hair feels well conditioned. but the best is the scent - who know bamboo could smell so good?? it is hard to describe, but it is a sweet, fresh scent that makes me look forward to wash days - and i'm usually intolerant to most scents. definitely recommend.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: can't get any better than this for us curly girls
Review: can't get any better than this for us curly girls. i've been buying this for years and will never ever try anything different! i've tried everything under the sun. combine this with the daily conditioner, and shampoo, and one other product i use and the curls are amazing. i get compliments every day.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: the best!
Review: this is my holy-grail product. for me, it creates soft, non-crunchy, non-sticky curls when scrunched and diffused or plopped. there is no heavy residue, very little to no frizz. it seems moisturizing and well as light hold. just love it. (fyi, i have 2b-2c waves, not sure of porosity but probably low to medium).

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i'm a believer!
Review: during quarantine, like many others, i discovered that my hair was a lot curlier than i imagined! in the course of integrating the curly girl method/products, this stuck out as one that helped other low-porosity people. i didn't notice a difference at first, but now that i've experimented with a lot of different products, this one is still part of my wash day routine. i add this right after leave-in and just before i apply a hard cast gel; i can literally feel it sucking the water into the core of my strands, and it takes my hair from dripping to just saturated with one application. once all three products are applied, i throw my hair up into a microfiber turban until i can diffuse (for anyone that was curious about my post-wash routine). hope this helps other low-porosity curlies out there!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: switched from deva to moptop
Review: i really was just trying to save some money after using devacurl products for a couple of years. deva is great, but it's really expensive, plus you should change up your product occasionally to give your hair a rest.i shopped around, checked reviews, even tried some samples of a few brands, and moptop products won the race by a mile! i'm currently using the no-poo cleansing conditioner, the daily conditioner, the leave-in conditioner, and the curly hair custard. the custard was my first purchase and came with some samples from the rest of the line.i will say it works much better with a little extra moisture underneath. after conditioning (or cleansing and conditioning if it's "wash" day) i apply a tiny bit of the leave-in while still in the shower with soaking wet hair. then i step out and apply a liberal amount of the curly custard, being sure to flip upside-down and side-to-side. then scrunch scrunch scrunch. i let it air dry then loosen the cast once it's completely dry. this can also be done with a diffuser, but i don't have time for blow dryers. i find i see a lot more frizz if i skip the leave-in.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: curly-girl life changer!
Review: my hairstylist recommended this product and it’s been a life changer!!! my curlyish hair has most often been noncommittal towards performing in my daily hopes before this. every night before bed i simply re-wet the ends of my hair, saturate it with mop top and go to bed. the wonderful fragrance is such a plus!  i wake up every morning with perfect, ready to go hair! my hair feels soft and the curls are perfect. throughout the day if i need a reboot ( swimming, shower any hair adventure), i just rewet my ends again, apply mop top and go! it drys quickly and no extra fussing is needed! buy it!!!!✨

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: just okay
Review: this was just okay for me. didn't provide any better results than lesser expensive products i can buy at my local retail outlet. i bought this because it is natural and minus the sulfates, which can dry out and damage hair and scalp. my scalp has been dry for some time and i have psoriasis, which does flare up from time to time., especially when my scalp is dry. i also changed shampoos at the same time, using a cleansing conditoner free of sulfates.i've been using it for a couple of weeks now and it hasn't really made a difference. additonally, it tends to create a slightly crispy texture in my hair.  this will probably not be the experience for most people as i have very, very kinky, frizzy curly hair. although each folicle is very fine, i have a lot of it, and with the extreme curl, it often feels almost coarse.i am scotch irish and just have crazier hair than most people here buying this product. however, if you share my genetic predisposition, please understand that this may not work for you either.that all being said, the product came well packaged and smells really nice. and i do like that it is natural. *sigh*

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: don't waste your money. this hurt my hair, and made it more frizzy.
Review: the smell is nice, and that is it. i have curly, fine hair, ringlets. this product i put on wet hair in the shower after the terrible moptop shampoo (which made my hair feel like straw). there was no moisture added. no detangling. afterward i used moptop curly custard, which is the only thing that added any moisture. i do not recommend this product, nor the shampoo. anywhere i didn't but the custard (because it weighs down my fine hair around scalp was a frizz show)

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: defines curls, but made my hair stringy
Review: i have 2c/3a wavy/curly hair. i used this in combination with the entire line of mop top products: the gentle shampoo, daily conditioner and leave-in conditioner. first, a little goes a long way. beware of using too much. however, i tried using varying amounts on numerous occasions, and every time, it defined my curls but made my hair stringy. i did not like the look. i think this product may just be too heavy for me. also, second day hair was frizzy and felt dry. unfortunately, i missed the return cutoff and am stuck with this expensive product i can't use. just didn't work for me.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: do not buy: broken seal with mold/object inside
Review: upon receiving my item i noticed dried product on the outside of the lid. i have a photo but the app only lets me post one. when i opened the package the seal was already broken. a lot of the product was dried along the rim of the container. upon closer inspection i noticed two black/green spots imbedded into the product. i assume this is mold or dirt. i cannot believe i paid such a high price for a defective, dried, dirty, and unsealed product. will not be purchasing from this supplier again.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: great for fine, low porosity, dry, 2a-b-c hair!
Review: this product has been superior compared to many other products i have tried for my wavy, fine, low porosity, medium density, shoulder length shag style hair that suffers from dryness, halo frizz and a mixed curl pattern. 6 months ago i decided to fully embrace my natural waves, use a slightly modified version of the cgm, and found that the front of my hair is 2c, the sides of my hair are 2b, and the back of my hair is 1c-2a. research suggested that hair similar to mine benefits most from lightweight, moisturizing products. i ended up focusing more on using a lower number of moisturizing products instead of multiple lightweight products. i've used as i am leave in conditioner for my dry hair since before i started this hair journey but decided to ditch it if i'm going to add on a curl activator/enhancer/gel. i tried cantu curl activator, which did almost nothing to define my waves and made my hair more frizzy. i tried maui moisture curl smoothie which did help enhance my waves (not in the back though), provided decent moisture, reduced some frizz, but did not have much hold- next day waves were basically not a thing and frizz was back. adding in curls blueberry bliss gel gave me almost no hold (upon purchasing i didn't realize it was a light hold gel) and was very drying so i ditched that quickly and replaced it with eco style gel (strong hold gel). it did help with definition and hold all around, not drying, but it wasn't optimal. i moved on to aunt jackie's defining curl custard and no gel which impressed me with the moisture, decent hold, reduced frizz, and enhanced definition even in the 2a back of my hair- but it contains silicones that i knew would eventually weigh down my hair. mop top curly hair custard gel had been on my list of cgm approved products to try and i should've gone with it ages ago because this product goes beyond aunt jackie's. i have defined waves all around, equal hold, and it is moisturizing. i've gotten the best defined next day waves compared to all other products i've tried. with other/no products, my halo frizz is usually worse the second and third day- but even with humectants being predominant in this product, i have had no halo frizz. i usually get frizz in both dry and humid environments, i have not yet had a chance to test it on a sufficiently humid day. i am optimistic though.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: nothing compares to this awesome product!
Review: i love moptop and this custard is key to my routine. i have a good amount of hair, so i use more than recommended, but nothing works better than this to hold my curl. i use the moptop oil to scrunch our tge crunch and my curls still hold! i also add a little to my water spray bottle and it becomes perfect for refreshing my curls and taking frizz for days 2-5!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: brings out the wave
Review: this is day one of using it and trying to revive the wave in my hair. with the length and dying my hair and brushing out, i very rarely have wave anymore. putting this in my hair and scrunching some before it dried gave me some wave. it’s a really light hold, no crunch and it doesn’t feel like i have any product build up. i’m hoping with some cowashing and adding another product on top of this one, it’ll look even better. smells great!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: wow!  finally a good hair curl product!!!
Review: when i was younger i had super straight hair.  seriously!  sometimes i had to perm it twice (it was the 80's when spiral perms were "in") just to get the curls to stick.  over the years my hair has evolved and it has slowly developed major frizz.  however, recently i've discovered that when tamed, that frizz is actually waves/curls!  i've purchased some creams and mousses recently to make the most out of my curls, but all of the products i've tried have always resulted in tacky-to-the-touch, frizzy and crunchy stiff hair.  i watched a couple of youtube videos and some of the ladies raved about this product and their curls did look lovely so i thought i'd by a jar and give it a try.  my jar arrived today and tonight i tried it.  it's amazing!!!  i towel dried my hair and applied this product to my damp hair.  this "custard" is runny but a little goes a long way so it didn't take much to cover my thin/fine hair.  i loved that it wasn't tacky and cause my hair to stick to my hand when i applied it.  i let my hair air-dry and i was happy to see that every time i checked on it, my curls were curling and there wasn't any frizz in sight!  when my hair was about  75% dry, i decided to defuse it and really give it the frizz test.  once again... no frizz and my curls were even more prominent!  i've been disappointed by so many products over the years so i am so incredibly happy to find a hair product that surpassed my expectations!  i'm new to moptop hair products but i'll definitely be giving other moptop products a try in the future.i highly recommend this product.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: not a fan
Review: i have thin, fine, wavy hair with low porosity, and had high hopes for this to nourish my hair without weighing it down.  it didn't.  if i stick with this and the moptop shampoo, i get a ton of buildup and my hair just looks and feels gross.i do have very hard water, so if yours is soft, you might have better results, but i'll be looking for something else.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: not for kinky/coily/transitioning hair!
Review: i was excited to try after reading so many fabulous reviews. i used this after using shampoo and conditioner and it was not thick enough nor did i feel like it penetrated the hair shaft. i tend to look the other way when i see a product that claims to work on all hair types including fine hair... i am a women of color and my hair is far from fine. save your money if you have kinky coarse textured hair as this will not be enough for you. if you have fine hair and are type 3 and above will probably work great for you.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: product cause sharp unbearble pain in my eyes :(
Review: the product is supposed to be organic but it burns eyes so much! it burns when you wash hair. and then a day later i got an unbearable sharp pain in my eyes that i could not open them because it felt like knife is cutting right through them. it took me a few episodes to understand what was causing that pain a day later after the wash. stopped using a product and the pain did not come back. never buying any of moptop products again!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: works
Review: i have a stubborn scalp , most products make my scalp break out to the point of itching so much it bleeds , since i have been using moptops gentle shampoo and daily conditioner ( almost a year now ) this problem has stopped .  i decided to give their leave-in conditioner a try as i do still get the flyaway frizzy stuff especially in humid weather . i have to admit that it feels strange when first applying to my hair , and i initially thought this would turn out to  be too heavy for my fine , slightly wavy hair , however after drying ( i only partially blow dry , i don't have enough time to be bothered with a full blow dry ) my hair isn't weighed down , it doesn't look greasy , it's shiny , smells good and it's soft . the frizzies are reduced to almost non existent . you don't need to use a lot of this either , my hair is half way down my back and it's fairly thick , i only use an amount that would equal maybe 2 nickels stacked on my palm and it does the job .

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: loving this product!!!
Review: i am having very positive results with this product. i can use a small amount (less than a teaspoon for sure) on my thick, wavy-to-curly, shoulder length hair and i get nice, soft, lovely waves/curls for at least three days. it renews with water in the morning. plus, my head never gets itchy and there’s no build up of product on my hair or scalp. i’m using it with other brands of sulfate and paraben free shampoo and conditioner, but when i run out, i’m curious to try other moptop products! it’s a pleasure to simply shampoo, condition and apply just this one styling product!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: nice!
Review: quite frankly i have been dreading wearing my hair curly after flat ironing it all winter and early spring. but the humidity is now at a point here in georgia that i can’t wear it straight even with anti-humidity hairspray. some aspects that i was dreading was my hair not drying for six hours and significant gel residue on the nape of my neck and on my chest that is even hard to get off with wet towel.  thankfully kinky curly was out of stock. i washed my hair and applied moptop and went outside in the hot sun and did yardwork. sweating profusely. most of my hair dried though! i pulled and stretched out the curls and still have good definition. going out for a walk with temp still 86f. will see how good of a hold i keep. that is always a challenge for me though. end of day my curls have lost a lot of definition. i have super fine non porous bi racial hair and have to scrunch my hair to get curls and use tangle teaser too, to help bring out my curls. very pleased

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: a product that i use. does not sit on the shelf.
Review: i am not sure why my very 4c hair thrives with this product. i have eczema and this does not result in a breakout. my hair feels soft and healthy. definitely provides the hydration my hair requires on a daily basis. the dry spots will thank you!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: amazing curl results
Review: i use this mop top product to create my  amazing beautiful 4b type hair curls.the results are amazing!!! nothing else is needed. i love this product. it leaves my hair moisturized & soft. this has been my go to product for a couples yrs now after being natural.the texture is of this product is of a gooey, slime gel, i rub it in with little effort & just really allow it to air dry or sometimes w/the use of a hand dryer.the curls are just truly defined, as i get compliments & request for my product use all the time.it’s a bit pricey but the product results are worth it.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: holy crap my hair has never been so happy
Review: i wish i would have known about this product before i cut off all of my hair. i went from frizz to happy curls in a matter of a few washes. it's difficult to keep my hair moisturized out here in the dry desert, so it's so satisfying to see happy hair after years of struggling with hagrid hair.the only downfall was the packaging. the bottles were just thrown in a paper sack with a little bit of tape on their lids. unfortunately the shampoo opened and i lost a good amount of shampoo.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: not enough for 3b hair
Review: fine blonde 3b hair, not heavy enough, not enough moisture, not enough slip. i have the custard too. i don't like the mop top brand. it's also too perfumey.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i don't understand the good reviews
Review: i barely ever leave reviews, but i wish there had been more reviews warning me about this product. it smells like nailpolish remover, and while it feels rather slimy or oily going on, it leaves my hair extremely dry. an hour after application, my hair looks like a frazzled mess that hasn't been conditioned in ages. the weird chemical smell lingers and is pretty unbearable, too. hair feels somehow both dry and greasy (!) to the touch.i have wavy 2b/2c hair and this might work for other types, even though this type of product usually works quite well for me, so i really just think it's this particular brand.i see other reviews saying that the product sold on amazon might have gone bad or is not comparable to the product you can buy elsewhere. maybe that's the problem? either way, i strongly recommend you don't order this for your hair!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: my new love!
Review: custards have never worked for my hair. i have mulitextured hair ranging from 2b to 3a. it's fine to medium and medium density. the moptop custard does not weigh my hair down at all and it doesn't leave a productly film i often get from other products. it definitely enhances my texture and gives me volume. i do have to top it off with another product for additional hold but that doesn't bother me...this stuff is holy grail for me.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: serious hydration that brought my curls back to life!
Review: this product literally brought my chemically treated, over dried, hair back to life!  it has shine and softness again.  no other deep conditioner has worked this effectively.  this morning i used quidad moisturizing shampoo and conditioner (blue line), then it's a 10 leave-in + keratin (orange top) spray onto drenched curls, and easily finger-combed the mop top curl custard through, and scrunched several times.  plopped my hair up in terry turban, while completing other tasks worth about 5-7 minutes. removed towel and clipped roots up.  once dry enough, removed clips.  my hair looked so good all work day.  left a light gel cast, similar to devacurl gel, until i manually loosened them up.  then the hair was soft and even more shiny.  this product is a must if you have over dry curls.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: unexpectedly good for mixed curls
Review: stuff is unexpectedly good, came in with low expectations. i’m a guy with medium length mixed 3a/c curls and most specialty products targeted at my hair type are either too heavy or too drying. have spent hundreds of dollars on product over the past two years. nothing i’ve tried before has been this good.hold, moisture, and shine all in one product. no need to layer product for my hair. routine since purchasing: co-wash with a cheap cg-approved conditioner, glide pick through hair, rinse, apply glob of mop top root to end, air dry and forget about it.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: soft but weight on hair
Review: i have low porosity 3c hair but needed some moisture. i am using mostly the as i am product line but they lack a true conditioner. i tried this conditioner to add moisture to my hair. while it does that and makes it very soft. it adds a lot of weight to my hair and adds to the frizzy. but if you are looking for moisture this is a great product.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: my go to curl secret
Review: this product has become a mainstay in my curly hair routine.  i have 3b curls, and it really leaves my hair soft and bouncy, people stop me in my tracks to ask what i use.  love the light cast it leaves once it dries, which i massage out to take my look to a soft non crunchy look.  i also love that there isn't a heavy scent - it's just right and fades away once dry. i hope the company keeps using the jar because that;'s the easiest way to style my curls, i just hate it when companies switch their products to bottles.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: 80’s perm scented.
Review: so if that’s your thing, go for it.  as mentioned in another review, this is so strongly scented as to exclude one from many public places. the curly custard smelt strongly of citrus, but the leave in, i’m sorry to have to say, smells chemical and just nasty. i know other people have said it smells great, so each to their own. btw, i’m not smell sensitive, and have never complained about scent before. jsyk.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: excellent curl custard
Review: i have half-a** white girl waves (2a-3a) from chemotherapy. this custard coaxes my waves into loose ringlets w/out weighing them down. the 1st jar i received was really runny & not custard-like at all but worked nicely. i'm on my 2nd jar is more custard/gel-like & giving me even better results.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: not the best for summer humidity
Review: packaging : definitely could have been better, the seal under the lid was barely attached and there was a little spillage of the gel because of that. the barcode/info sticker looked like it had gotten wet at some point. however the contents of the container appear to be in good condition.performance: nice texture to the gel, applies easily, smells good, dries relatively quickly. decent amount of hold but more difficult to completely break the cast than kinky curly custard. does have a lot of glycerin in it so it is not good in the summer humidity. my normally minimally frizzy 2b wavy hair looked poodle-esk after only a few minutes out air conditioning. i also had some white flaking as it apparently interacts with miss jessie’s  curl cream.overall it’s an okay purchase if it’s not humid outside and i’m in a hurry to leave the house with dry hair. i think it will be more of a winter product and will update back.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: well worth the money!
Review: i have been going through trying many “clean” curly girl approved products and this and the custard are in my top 5.  leaves hair so soft and defined!  must have curl products for me!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: good product
Review: this cuts oil a little more effectively than other co-washes but moisturizes less. i use it on my roots and another in my length. it’s a good product and for the correct hair type a great hair product. i have mixed hair with a loose curl and a slight tendency towards dryness. i use it on my daughter who has very curly hair and it works well to get all of the days messes out of her hair although i must follow up with a deep conditioner

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: this conditioner is amazing! it is the only conditioner that will actually ...
Review: this conditioner is amazing! it is the only conditioner that will actually moisturize my lower then low porosity hair. everything else has too much protein, or too much oil for my hair, leaving it dry and brittle. i have fine wavy hair, but a lot of it. this moisturizes very well, but never leaves my hair weighed down or greasy. it actually gets into my hair shaft, rather then just sitting on top! i have tried so many conditioners, and can not handle chemical smells. this is scented with citrus essenial oils, and the smell does not linger. it is also a very pure, natural product, which is very important to me. i am very grateful to mop top for making such a wonderful product. if not for this, my poor hair would be dry as a dessert. don't ever stop making it!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: product causes a burning sharp pain in my eyes:(
Review: the product is supposed to be organic but it burns eyes so much! it burns when you wash hair. and then a day later i got an unbearable sharp pain in my eyes that i could not open them because it felt like knife is cutting right through them. it took me a few episodes to understand what was causing that pain a day later after the wash. stopped using a product and the pain did not come back. never buying any of moptop products again!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: would be great if it weren't for the smell...
Review: as a product, it's great — does exactly what it says it does and does it well. frankly, this would probably be my favorite product of all time if it weren't for the sickly-sweet and overpowering scent that just reminds me of cheap sugary products. i don't smell the "citrus" at all. i used it this morning and although the scent has faded over time, my headache that came from it is still lingering. if there's an unscented version of this product, i'd jump on it without hesitation. as is, though, i wouldn't buy it again.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i loveee
Review: i have 2b hair that is just below shoulder length. used this tonight for the first time during squish to condish, after applying a leave in. i used maybe 3 quarter sizes worth of product and i did not use any gel, because after reading the reviews i was really curious to see what it would do on its own. it did create a *little bit* of a cast.my hair looks great, however next time i'll use a little more product and see what happens. and then i'll try a bit of gel with it, and report back. so far i am very happy with this product.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: smoothe defined curls
Review: this product is great! keeps my curls defind while not weighing them down. i use a leave in conditioner and oils with it. when i break the cast after it dries my curls are smoothe and soft. much lighter than eco or kinky curly, and no sticky feeling.my official go-to.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: best curl custard
Review: i have very fine 2c/3a hair. almost everything weighs it down. this curl custard does not. it makes my curls bouncy. i use leave in, then the curl custard, then a tiny amount of hard hold gel. then i diffuse the roots and let the rest air dry. will be purchasing the 16oz jar from now on. will also be transferring to a pump bottle. the smell is not my favorite but does disappear once it dries. will continue to purchase!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: didn't work for me
Review: i bought this based off a review i saw on ig. although this smelled great and made my hair super shiny, i ended up throwing it away. once it dried it flaked so bad and got all over my clothes. it looked like i had terrible dandruff. what a waste of money! back to bellacurls!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: absolutely horrible. please read
Review: i tried to give this product the benefit of the doubt. i even tried it for a full 3 months. however, the smell and quality is absolutely horrendous. if you like smelling like candied coconut mixed with playdough...you'll love this scent! i had to spray hairspray or perfume on my head anytime i conditioned with this. not only that, it left the most residue and buildup in my hair i've ever had. let me remind you, i used this for 3 months, not changing any other products and this conditioner made my hair greasy, stringy, and smelling like a literal child covered in playdough. honestly, the worst conditioner i have ever used in my life.
HairConcerns: frizz, dryness, volume, breakage, shine, split ends

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: works great on small child
Review: i'm a new to curly hair products because my daughter has curly hair and i don't.  her hair is fairly wavy but before mop top it just looked messy so i always put it up in pony tails.  i got recommended a bunch of products but was looking for a more affordable option for my 4 year old.  i really like this stuff.  it smells great (so good that i use it in my hair to keep down my fly always because of the nice scent!).  it helps define her curls in the morning.  we hair wash at night, so by morning her hair is just a wavy bed head mess.  all i really need is this mop top stuff, although sometimes i do a detangler or mousse.  but i've found mop top is all i really need to make her hair presentable to wear curly.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: best hair product i have ever tried!
Review: i read the reviews and was kind of nervous about spending the money for something i had never heard of! i hate stuff that leaves my hair feeling dirty or heavy! i'm so glad i took the leap! i made my mom try it (who never does anything with her hair) and it made her hair so much healthier looking... and brought the curls out so nicely! my niece, who is mixed, tried it... and she loved it as well! so pretty much... it doesn't matter how curly your hair is, or what nationality you are... try this! no regrets!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: not bad
Review: i didn't dislike this product, i'm just finding that i don't like this kind of consistency much. i've tried other custards and a flaxseed gel with the same consistency and it just isn't my thing. i have fine hair, and used this at the beginning of my cg transistion, so it was kind of a 2a-2b wave. the product was nice for a wash-and-wear, one product look. it also smells like sprite to me, which is a pleasant and not over powering smell. unlike some custards, it didn't make my hair look stringy if i used a little too much. i gave what i had left to a friend with coarser, 3b-3c hair and she likes it as a wash-and-wear as well.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: great moisture without the weight
Review: i chose this light conditioner to try out on my daughters fine, straight hair, and also wanted something lighter for my fine 2b waves. i really like it for both of our hair. it actually leaves my daughter's fine hair kind of plumped. if you leave it in awhile, it deeply moisturizes and feels almost like buttery smooth. yet still is so light, unlike butters and oils that weigh hair down.  it's keeping my 2b waves much more bouncy as oppose to some of the heavier butter like cowashing i did in the past.  i plan to use this for my daily conditioner.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: tainted product!
Review: do not order this from amazon!!!can't believe after removing the outside plastic seal, this is what the inner seal looked like. it is dissolving. the section missing from the lid was down inside the product. i went to remove it and it disintegrated. gone! returning and only ordering from moptop direct. this is not going on my hair!!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: allergenic?
Review: i have never had an allergy to anything, except to something in this cowash. my scalp was covered in blisters. aside from the reaction, i didn’t find this to be cleansing at all and my hair looked greasier after using this cowash than it did prior to washing. smells nice though.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: rinses well
Review: i appreciate the value of this product in terms of quantity and quality which definitely justifies its price. i chose this because it was recommended by the cgm website for those with long 2a hair. it rinses well where i do not have to stand long in the shower just to rinse it off. it makes my hair really shiny without being weighed down. i wish this came in a bigger bottle with a pump.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i didn't think i had waves! i do!
Review: i went for a perm, but my stylist talked me or of it-she said i had volume and waves, i just needed the right cut and products. she added some layers and sold me some shampoo, and i bought some mop top, after reading reviews. after about a month of using this product, plus avoiding straightening, i actually have a head full of bouncy waves! the scent dries fresh and mild, it doesn't leave hair crunchy, and it spreads lightly and evenly.  i recommend trying it, and i will be purchasing more!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: do not buy
Review: this product leaves your hair looking disgusting. it flakes like crazy, which makes no sense because it’s for curly hair so it should be scrunchable. not even close, don’t waste your money.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: excellent product for defining curls!
Review: this is my first experience with moptop. i’m a loyal deva curl user for many years but my curly hair is getting looser the older i get, and a good product is needed more than ever to alleviate frizz and define curl. the smell is a mild citrus, very tolerable, and the texture appears water soluble and blended well into my damp hair. no residue and dried slightly crisp which i could somewhat shake out. however i prefer a stronger hold, especially as the day wears on in humidity. the key is to leave your hair alone when you apply product and that’s always a challenge. with deva, i combine several different products to get good hold. this one does it all by itself. i’m very pleased so far.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: no slip
Review: i purchased bc a cgm youtuber said this conditioner had great slip - absolutely not! no slip at all, didn’t help with tangles at all.also - less of a big deal- i had to squeeze package so hard that i creased the packaging. this is with the bottle full of product.  i cannot imagine how difficult it would have been later.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: amazing!
Review: i rarely write product reviews, but this sh*t is amazing. the internet made me buy it—specifically, the real life curly girl on youtube. i have wavy (2b if you follow curly girl method) hair that is long, medium density, medium thickness, and pretty porous (colored). this product is not heavy, is not crunchy, and provides some volume with zero frizz. it can be used on its own for curl and medium hold or under a gel as just a curl activator. new holy grail—i keep trying other things, and they don’t come close. i was not paid for this review.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: great stuff and smells good
Review: my fine 2b curls loved this stuff! plus it didn’t weigh my hair down which is always my biggest issue. i used it with the curly custard by mop top. great combo for nice hold and hydration!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: holy grail for 2b-2c fine hair!
Review: i have 2b/c, high porosity, low density, fine hair and this stuff is magic! i've tried kccc (many curly girls holy grail product) and it's way too heavy and pulls out my curls/waves no matter how little i use or how much emulsify with water. this stuff helps my waves hold moisture, they clump beautifully, they last 3 days (with minimal refresh), and i can use it alone if i'm in a rush. this is my holy grail custard...but pair it with ecoslay orange marmalade for phenomenal results (and 3-4day hair)!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: works great
Review: i've tried quite a few sulfate free shampoos trying to find one that won't irritate my scalp , they either leave my hair greasy or they dry it right out or they cause my scalp to be more irritated than it already is . this stuff cleans really well , doesn't irritate my scalp , smells great and paired with the daily conditioner makes my hair soft . it helps tame some of the frizz , not all of it . i have highlighted hair that's slightly wavy and haven't seen where this shampoo has removed any of the color . an added bonus is that my scalp is feeling much better after 2 weeks of using this shampoo no more bumps along hairline or scalp . i just wish it wasn't so pricey .

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: wavy girls must have!
Review: i have tried everything curly girl approved, and this is by far the best product i have used.  i ditched all the creams, custards and gels by diva curl, lus, ouidad, treluxe, etc.  now, i use these brands of shampoos and conditioners, but i only use this styling product in the shower.  my hair is fine and wavy, and this works really well.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i'm so torn
Review: my hair loves this product; it's soft and shiny when i use it my curls end up perfectly defined without being crunchy.  however, the smell is overwhelming and never goes away.  it's bad enough to give me a headache.  i have eczema and i'm pretty sure if i use it too often, it'll end up making it flare up so i don't recommend this if you have eczema or asthma or are otherwise sensitive to scents.for now, i'm using homemade flaxseed gel and just layering a small amount of this over it.  i really wish moptop would make an unscented version or just not dump an entire vat of fragrance into their otherwise wonderful product.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: ineffective and stinky 😞
Review: while i can see it's helping to define my curls a *bit* better than if i used no product at all, unfortunately it's done nothing to get rid of any of the frizz. i'm still experimenting with it, so we'll see. but i also had to knock some points off because the overwhelming stink of lemon pledge! thankfully the smell goes away when it dries, but it doesn't seem like a good thing for it to smell like floor cleaner in the first place. overall, i'm far from impressed. 👎

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: great gentle shampoo
Review: very moisturizing formula. i love that it clarifies gently and isn't loaded with heavy proteins and butters which give me build up. i rotate washing with this and as i am cowash. this is the one i reach for if i want something a little more clarifying. it's a great curly girl friendly shampoo.*update:still my favorite shampoo. since buying this i've tried giovanni's 50/50 which didn't work as well.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: honestly this product was a major disappointment. i’ve heard so many great things about it ...
Review: honestly this product was a major disappointment. i’ve heard so many great things about it made me buy it. the first time i used it on my wet hair i loved how it felt and things were good but from great to horrible didn’t take too long. once my hair dried it was over. my curly wasn't defined in any way nor did it hold the shape. then i nothing it was crunchy and hard and then the flakes happened. it was horrible to the point other people noticed it. by the way, this was just after one try and yes i followed the direction.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: disappointed
Review: first time i put this leave in conditioner my hair was wet and as it dried it was very for the i put more products on and it still is frizzy but now it has a filmy feel to it i am not happy at all the outcome is nothing like the description

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: 2b fine wavy - thumbs up
Review: this is my first cgm  product and i loved it. i have compared it to as i am cowash and this one gives me better results.i use this as cowash or after i use moptop low poo cleanser. i’ve seen my waves actually clump and not look flat. smells great, not strong and lingering.only con, not enough product. finished bottle in a month (cowashed about 3xs a week)but will consider buying it again if no other product compares.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: for curly girls, it's all about the product!
Review: with naturally curly hair, it's all about the product, and you can't go wrong with moptop!! i love everything i've used from them (& love 'em best whenever i've stuck with using their haircare and cocktailed their stylers.) hands down this is my favorite product they make, and it's perfect when combined with their medium hold natural gel. love, love, love their performance ...and also their clean, citrusy, lovely scent! they even have great how-to videos on their website on hair care & styling ...done by curly girls for curly girls! 💜❤🧡

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: fantastic product for adding "oomph" to natural curls and waves
Review: i love this product. i bought a tub of it back in september 2018 and i just finally ran out in may 2019. coming on here to order more made me realize i should leave a review! a little bit of this goes a long way and you really don't need to use more than a nickel to quarter size amount depending on how much hair you have. too much will actually cause you to end up with flakes so definitely start cautiously until you figure your perfect amount out. the photo i attached has the wash day before i received this product not using any curl activators on the left and then the wash adding this product into my line-up on the right. i think it's pretty obvious that it works!

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: crunch city
Review: i don’t know if i did something wrong or what but after reading all the great reviews i was super excited to try this. firstly, it came with the seal half on half off. secondly, it made my hair crunchier than any other product i have ever used, yuck!!! i was so self consious of my hair all day i ended up putting it in a messy bun (on a wash day, ugh!). i will maybe try again and use less (even though i don’t feel like i used that much??) and update if it’s better next time but so far, bad impression :(
HairConcerns: dryness, frizz, volume, breakage, shine, split ends, heat damage

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: favorite conditioner ever!
Review: i love this conditioner. i have super thick coarse hair and i generally use a handful of conditioner.  not with this though! i need about 2 quarters worth and it's plenty! the slip is amazing. it makes my hair detangle almost instantly. i love the smell too. it doesn't linger if you're worried about that.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: i used this product alone and it worked fine. it does leave a crunchy cast which is ...
Review: i need to use this more to get more consistent results since i have never used it before  this purchase and this is a new purchase. i used this product alone and it worked fine. it does leave a crunchy cast which is good for wavy/curly girls to maintain a curl pattern. i scrunch it out later if i air dry or even after i diffuse. i have never used a hair custard before. a little goes a looong way which is good for the price. it feels like the slim i used to play with as a little girl, and the smell is nice and citrusy. it is up in the air if i will repurchase it and if so, it won't be for a long time because the tub is large.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: jury is still out...
Review: from other reviews, i knew it was not a heavy hold product. i did think it would be more of a "custard" texture as opposed to a thin gel texture. just began using it, not sure if i will order again. i have short, thin, loose curly hair.

Product: ﻿MopTop Curl Enhancer Gel, Reduces Frizz, Natural Ingredients, Kinky-Coily Curly Hair Gel, Made w/ ﻿Aloe, Sea Botanicals & Honey, (﻿Citrus Medley, 8oz)
Title: perfect for 3a-c hair with curly girl method
Review: been using this gel for a couple of years straight, in about a 3:1 ratio with leave-in conditioner, plus a few drops jojoba oil. fantastic shine and texture, light, bouncy, low buildup. scent is lovely. hope they make this product forever. i can’t vouch for other curl types, but this is ideal for type 3!

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Conditioner (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: does not moisturize
Review: i did not care for the smell and this actually left my curls feeling dry and coarse.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Conditioner (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: my favorite hair conditioner
Review: i have not found another that detangles my hair as good as this! it makes it easy to cowash, very moisturizing and lots of slip! it smells good but very strong and does triggers my headaches. it don’t stop me from using it though! that’s how good it is.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Conditioner (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: rancid shampoo and plastic conditioner
Review: i wish i was allowed to return this item, but apparently when i ordered it as a subscription you can't return things. i opened it up and the shampoo smells rancid. definitely not anything floral or tropical that i was expecting. the conditioner (which should smell the same) smells like plastic or latex. again, not floral, tropical, or even good. i'm hoping it's a bad batch i was given that was expired, since i've used other nym products and not had this problem. guess i'll go to the drugstore and buy it in person where i can smell if it's gone bad. i certainly won't buy from this supplier again.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Conditioner (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: terrible for my hair
Review: i have other products from nym’s that i love, but this particular shampoo and conditioner were terrible on my hair!  after using it my hair felt very weighed down, sticky and super oily - which is a bummer because i really liked the scent.  but i think i’ll stick with their other products.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Conditioner (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: best curl shampoo out there
Review: this shampoo/conditioner really enhanced my natural curls. the smell is tropical and keeps my hair healthy.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: good for low porosity curls
Review: ok 1. for ppl saying “description says 16 bottles” lol what? it says dual pack, 15oz ..dual means two and idk where anyone would think they’d get 16 if anything for $16. dont review poorly because you lack reading comprehension2. this smells amazing and makes my hair so soft. but if u have high porosity hair u will have to add protein

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: first time use - good results, bad price
Review: ***edit***i'm editing my original review because of something i just learned. being new to cgm and the different products, i didn't realize that the price on this product was higher than it should have been. while visiting my local walgreens, i found the exact same brand and sized bottles, 16 oz, for $8 a piece. this seller is gouging customers by charging $30+ for the set! absolutely unacceptable and while i will definitelycontinueusing the product, i will never purchase from this seller .***smells really great without being too strong. after my first use, i was very happy with the curl outcome and will continue using. my only complaint is regarding the packaging. the pump is way too short and doesn't give enough product at one time. the product itself is great.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: description says 16 bottles, but only got 2
Review: this description said you would get 8 shampoos and 8 conditioners. so i paid the huge price for it. when it came, there was only one shampoo and one conditioner, and both pumps on the bottles were broken off. the description clearly says 16 bottles, and i would never have paid so much money for two bottles. infuriating

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: great product and great value!!
Review: i absolutely love this shampoo and conditioner. my hair is so soft and moisturized after using it. i also love the scent!!! 10/10 recommend - great product foe the price.after following the curly girl method for about a year, i’ve come to a routine where i wash with the shampoo, rinse, rake conditioner through my hair, brush conditioner, and squish to condition (leaving most of the conditioner in my hair). i love the results! i won’t go back to any other shampoo i’ve tried before.i hope this helps!!

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: love the product but the pumps could be a lot better
Review: i have wavy hair and i have been embracing the texture recently and using products that amp up the curl factor. i really love this shampoo/conditioner set. it smells amazing and it brings out my curls. my only issue is that the conditioner pump was broken when it arrived. i have to just take the lid off and squeeze it out during my showers. it wasn't worth it to me to try and send it back but it is an annoyance. the pumps themselves feel pretty cheap so i am not surprised that one failed before it even arrived. that being said, i do really like the product itself and i will probably continue to buy it, hopefully the next set works properly.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: curly girl method approved
Review: have been trying to do the curly girl method and these to products are approved and make my hair look great. i can get beautiful clumps of curls without having yucky buildup on my hair.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Review: item description clearly states 16 count.  only recieved 2. never would have paid 34 dollars for this product.  it is a very good product but not good enough to be mislead by seller in description.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: not "natural ingredients" and shampoo strips all the moisture
Review: i'd skip the shampoo and find a more moisturizing one if you've got curlies. i'm unsure what i expected, it says natural but it's "natural" meaning, nah, bb this is all chemicals with a nice scent.it smells nice but i'm pretty sure i just spent $40 on drug store product. the shampoo completely strips my hair to the point it feels like straw and the conditioner works well...but would it work better if the poo didn't strip? probably. is it thick? i guess? feels about the same as anything.i'm disappointed and i'll probably move this along to someone else.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: very moisturizing no protein
Review: so this shampoo and conditioner is great for people who are protein sensitive and need a lot of moisture. that is not me. i need a decent amount of protein in my routine and 2 months after purchasing my hair was over moisturized and lost a lot of volume. this is definitely a case of my hair not responding well to a good product and not that the product is bad. i would recommend this to anyone who is in protein overload or is protein sensitive, this is just not for me

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: great curl defining shampoo and conditioner!
Review: i have wavy, frizzy hair. when i started using this shampoo and conditioner i was a skeptic. each time i wash my hair with not your mother’s naturals curl defining products i get luscious curls without frizz. it’s magical! i’ve never liked my hair down and natural but now i love it! my curls are so pretty and i no longer feel as though i have to wear my hair up in a ponytail to mask the kinkiness and waves.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: so worth it!
Review: besides going to the salon to get your hair done i swear to you it's the best shampoo and conditioner i ever bought 😌 i'm so unbelievably happy with how my hair feels after a wash.. also this is a great foaming shampoo unlike most where it feels like it just sits there. this feels like it goes right to my scalp making it feel oh so good... i could really go on and on but give it a try you won't be disappointed i promise you.. i got the set for curl defining

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: conditioner is weak
Review: the shampoo is really nice, lightly floral and fruity scented, slightly moisturizing.the conditioner is a flop, the consistency is a lot thinner than most conditioners. it feels like water and is barely even useful to detangle my hair in the shower. i tried letting it sit in my hair for a few minutes while washing up and it kinda just washes off really fast without feeling like it did anything. found myself struggling to detangle my curls in the shower which is bad for a product meant for curly hair.would recommend if you have thin of fine hair  since it's light weight and non greasy. unfortunately if you have curly hair i'd recommend just getting the shampoo and finding a different conditioner.
HairConcerns: frizz, dryness, split ends, volume, breakage, shine, heat damage

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: did nothing for my curls
Review: in fact, this made my hair much worse. i have more split ends than i’ve ever had. it just doesn’t moisturize in a good way. in the shower it feels nice, sure. feels like my hair will get moisture. the conditioner is really heavy, but once rinsed out it gave my hair a sort of heavy and dry feeling. i have very wavy asian mixed hair. the smell is nice, but would not buy again. the amount of buildup this combo gave me was insane. i usually wash my hair every 3 days, but needed a daily wash with this.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: misleading description! not as advertised!
Review: this ad is fraudulent and misleading. it clearly states a 16 count which means 8 shampoos and 8 conditioners. i received two items. $35 for two bottles of over-the-counter shampoo and conditioner which retail for about $5 or $6 a piece, is price scouging. i love this product, but i will not pay astronomical prices for it. the seller is completely unethical, completely misleading and this should be taken down or updated immediately.
HairConcerns: volume, breakage, shine, heat damage, frizz, color-treated

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: the only stuff that works on our hair
Review: i have had annoying to handle curls/waves all my life and being married and having to cover my hair... i'm grateful lol bc i hated dealing with it. we have two toddlers with very beautiful,curly hair. their hair gets knotty and this brand has a detangler which is the only effective detangler we've found, so i tried this and i don't even need the detangler most times. this makes their curls so bouncy and defined. love this brand

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: conditioner has amazing slip !!
Review: i don't usually ever write reviews but this product is amazing !! i have 3b/3c hair and have never  detangled my hair so fast and easily as with this conditioner. i haven't tried the shampoo yet but i am super excited for my next wash !! definitely recommend this brand and product for all hair types !! also cgm approved :))

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: kind of a let down
Review: so many people following the curly girl method have recommended this shampoo and conditioner that i had to try it. i just wasn't impressed. it left my waves flat and lifeless. also, i expected this stuff to smell amazing. the scent of the shampoo was very faint floral and the conditioner lacked a scent but somehow managed to smell bad. it's almost as though they forgot to put the scent in the mixture before bottling it. what a let down. i only used it a few times before throwing the bottles away.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: super greasy hair
Review: the product has a great smell and the shampoo works pretty well...it's the conditioner that's the issue.  there is no happy medium...if you don't rinse enough then you have this greasy weird residue in your hair that looks like you didn't wash it. if you rinse too much then it is like you have no conditioner at all. it does not work for my hair at all. i can't stand the feeling of being able to still feel the conditioner in my hair like gel.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: love it!
Review: i have a lot of skin allergies and so there really isn't that many shampoos i can use. i had used another shampoo in this brand but the price had tripled so i found this set. it smells so good. i don't have curly hair at all - it's very straight but idc. imma gonna use it anyways. ha

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls
Title: great everyday wash
