Review: working in a hospital and having curly hair is a difficult balancing act when it comes to frizzy dry hair. i love the smell and fact that i can fully wash my hair everyday without it drying out or getting all frizzy. nice light scent too. also if you follow a low poo/cg method these are perfect.

Product: Not Your Mother's Naturals Curl Definition Shampoo (2-Pack) - 15.2 fl oz - Tahitian Gardenia Flower & Mango Butter - Moisturize and Enhance Curls

Title: better
Review: i don't know why but my previous review is gone... so that's odd. i will have to check back to see if this one stays up. i wrote a bad review before so i am not sure if they had it removed or what but basically i received my first order opened without a cap and missing product/leaking/with dirty fingerprints, as if it had been used. i really liked that this has a high rating as far as safe ingredients for a heat protector for your hair, so i decided to send it back and get a new one sent back to me as a replacement despite this first impression not being so good.i am re-writing this review after receiving a replacement. hopefully this one stays up. but basically the new one they sent back i like a lot more. performance-wise, it seems to do the trick well as a heat protectant. it even works well as a leave-in conditioner if you are not heat styling your hair to give it more softness and to moisturize any frazzled ends. i applied to my hair where it is dry and it softened it immediately after running my fingers into it.my favorite part is definitely that they use all safe ingredients. it is also cruelty-free along with a few other environmentally conscious aspects.the only con is that this is not lightly scented whatsoever so if you are sensitive to fragrances, you may not be a fan. i'm not ordinarily a fan of highly fragranced things myself and i was thinking it would be a light shea butter with a bit of peppermint smell, since it says it has peppermint in it for some reason (on the back it states it has pepperming to make your "scalp tingle" - i don't know why they would need to do that as this is not a shampoo).but no, it doesn't even smell at all like peppermint. it instead has a strong sweet smell like sugary frosting on a cake. it indeed does smell very similar to cake frosting, if i had to give it a name. kind of a strange scent for what the ingredients are. so, if you can't get past smelling distinctly like a birthday cake all day it may not be your thing. it wears off a little bit over the day but it really is quite strong at first and lingers on your hands even after washing them off. the strong and unusual smell for a heat protectant spray is why i knock off one star. everything else seems great so far.

Title: i will buy this until they stop making it!
Review: i have used many conditioners specifically for more hair moisture.  of that lot, the best were organic root stimulator's (ors) olive oil replenishing conditioner and nexxus humectress.  both have more chemicals than i would like, and i was searching for something more natural as i am now relying on keratin treatments.i decided to try good old shea moisture.  i am more familiar with their body washes, scrubs, and lotions than hair products, but as this was a package deal that gave 2 conditioners, i decided to give this a try.wow what a difference!  no matter what i have done to my hair, it is soft.  and i can use it with my daughter's natural hair, too. she has a great deal of it, very long, with a looser curl pattern.  you don't need much of it to saturate your hair with it, and it is mostly (all?) natural!

Product: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Mafura Oil Intensive Hydration Hair Masque, with African Rock Fig & Baobab Oil, 12 Ounce - 2 pack
Title: intense moisture
Review: this is a very, very moisturizing deep conditioner.  i purchased it to ensure i put moisture back in my hair after a recent relaxer.  it did not fail me at all.  it has a lot of slip, doesn’t take a lot to coat your strands, and it smells amazing.  i sat under a dryer for 30 minutes to get the most out of the conditioner.  once rinsed, comb out was a breeze.  i recommend this to anyone with relaxed or natural hair in need of intense moisture.  i will definitely buy again.

Product: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Mafura Oil Intensive Hydration Hair Masque, with African Rock Fig & Baobab Oil, 12 Ounce - 2 pack
Title: best mask
Review: this has been my go-to hair mask for a long time now. i have fine (diameter of each hair shaft is small) but thick (a very large number of strands) hair, which is also wavy, curly, frizzy. it is very difficult to manage, in my own opinion and that of professional hair stylists too! i use this mask *after every* shampoo, rather than conditioner. i'll concentrate the mask at mid to ends of my hair, and then run the remainder of the mask across my roots, to give them some moisture without weighing down my roots too much. i then gently run a wide tooth comb through my hair and gently massage each section  to work the mask into the strands. after that i pile my hair on top of my head, loosely with a clip and cover my hair in a plastic shower cap and do the rest of my showering (exfoliating, shaving, etc.) every now and then, if my hair needs extra moisture and softening, i'll put a towel turban over the plastic shower cap, to trap some of the heat from my head which helps the mask penetrate into the hairs, then get out of the shower, letting the mask sit for a half hour or so before rinsing with cool/cold water. this mask has definitely helped a lot with keeping each strand moisturized and preventing breakage, which occurs for me when my fine hairs are overly dried out. it does the most work for minimizing frizz, so then i only need my everyday styling products to do the rest.for my hair type, this mask is not too heavy but i have friends with thin (quantity of strands) fine (diameter of strands) hair, who said it made their hair look oily and weighed down.it smells *delicious*, with a hint of honey. the formula itself is very thick and is in a soft, solid form in the tub, which makes it feel very luxurious and nourishing. this is one of the only products i buy in bulk with automatic orders!

Title: product from the heavens!!!!!
Review: let’s be very clear here. since going back to relaxers i’m more educated and now very aware of products that state and claim that your hair will feel like this or that and with shea products through the blogs the brand has always been extremely recommended for natural hair.....however!!!!!! this product here bbaaabbbyy!!!!!let me tell you. i once was natural but realized that wasn’t for me after 3 years and then got the big chopped and went back to relaxers. store products which were very few were recommended by my beautician especially when i wasn’t able to get a appointment with her. i learned just because you have new growth does not mean to have to be a slave to a beauty salon or a relaxer for that matter. so i would allow my relaxers to go about 8 weeks. i did this once and my hair instantly start breaking off and my beautician stated it was because of the store bought products that i used outside of her recommendations. they would dry my hair out as if i never put a product in it, but this time around i said well let me go about 12 weeks out and then as i was about to relax it i said well let me trim it and wear a protective style. my hair had moisture from the products i was using but i seen myself slipping back down that slippery slope of breakage again. so i went out to sally’s to buy a relaxer and should’ve known they wouldn’t have my brand/product that i prefer  but i turned around and seen this! now i don’t know about you guys, but i will literally stop in the middle of the aisle and whip my phone out to see the reviews on the product. let’s just say i’m moving into week 16 without an relaxer, hair moisturize, no breakage, shiny , feel strong and even my edges are slick!!!!! this is a must buy and i recommend the moisture spray as well. don’t be alarmed by the thickness of the product.. put a plastic cap on and wear for 15 min and rinse and there you go!!!!!

Product: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Yogurt Hydrate + Repair Protein Power Treatment, Hair Mask, Deep Conditioner and Hair Treatment, 8 oz
Title: buy it somewhere cheaper but definitely buy it!!
Review: this same size is way cheaper at ulta or target so buy it from there but the product itself is amazing. my hair is transitioning from relaxed to natural and i have been looking for something to help with the breakage so i don't have to do the big chop. i use this a pre-wash treatment and it works wonders. my hair does not shed as much while washing and it stops the breakage after i style my hair. i wear my hair straight most days and before using this i couldn't even run my fingers through it without pieces breaking off. now i can comb and style however i want & the difference is notable for at least 10 days or more. i wash my hair every two weeks and use this every time. unlike other protein treatments, i don't find that it leaves my hair hard or dry but that also might be because of how i use it (pre-wash instead of post). i leave it on for about 30 min w/a plastic cap before i wash my hair and then rinse it out completely before i shampoo. my hair grows and i can trim the ends in manageable segments without having to cut so much at one time so i don't lose my length while transitioning. i don't like all of shea moisture's products but this is definitely a winner!!

Title: made my hair stink
Review: wife here: if you’re like me and you just read amazon reviews to see what people have to say about the product then that’s what this is. my review has nothing to do with the seller, or the authenticity of the product from this seller. i bought a container at target and have used it a few times. it smells heavenly! i was so excited to try it. my hair felt great after using it. however, once my hair air dried i found that my hair smelled like a mans gym bag. it was gross. i’ve used this 5 or 6 times now! i may try it again, maybe with a different shampoo? idk i can’t think why my shampoo or air drying my hair would make my hair smell this bad. i’ve only had my hair smell that bad after putting apple cider vinegar in it, but if you put something that smells bad in your hair your hair will smell bad, so i can’t imagine what’s going on here....if given a choice between frizzy, damaged hair for the rest of my life or having hair smell the way this product did i’d choose the damaged hair.

Product: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Yogurt Hydrate + Repair Protein Power Treatment, Hair Mask, Deep Conditioner and Hair Treatment, 8 oz
Title: deep conditioner
Review: i purchased this product, as a sample, at ulta beauty.  i have used it for the last two weeks and it helps my hair.  i am a black woman with short, course, hair, that basically goes into an afro, no matter what i do.  i generally roll my hair up every night and when i go out, it just frizzes up.  since i have been using this product, my curls are tighter, more defined and they hold.  even when i exercise in the evening, the kinking is not too bad.  it is raining today in dc, tuesday nov 13 and the rain didn't even frizz my hair.  so, i would recommend this product.  i wash my hair with a moisturizing shampoo and then apply this for about 8 minutes, wash out, apply leave in and castor oil and roll my hair damp.  i have given up, trying to press it out.  this product makes my hair look as if it were pressed out.  smells good also.

Product: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Yogurt Hydrate + Repair Protein Power Treatment, Hair Mask, Deep Conditioner and Hair Treatment, 8 oz
Title: loved the product when i figured out how to use it!
Review: i recently had my hair bleached and wanted to look into products to help return moisture and protein to my hair after having it processed like that, because it felt a little dry and frail and frizzy. i purchased this through another retailer, and i've been really enjoying it! my hair feels softer than it did before i bleached it, eveni had trouble with it at first because i was trying to use too much product and fully saturating my hair, but after i started thinly applying it to my fingers and combing it through my curls instead of gobbing it on which left a crunchy cast and bad hair feeling, i had a lot of success! i'm really happy with the way my curls are behaving and how soft my hair feels after using it :)

Product: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Yogurt Hydrate + Repair Protein Power Treatment, Hair Mask, Deep Conditioner and Hair Treatment, 8 oz
Title: amazing product for curls!

Title: 10-Oct
Review: this stuff is amazing. i am biracial with thick, unruly hair that is relaxed, and it’s always so dry and brittle, no matter how much i moisturize. like even when my hair soaking wet, you can just feel how dry it is, ya know? i used this once and my hair has done a complete 180. the jar says to leave it on for 10-15 minutes but i left it on for an hour, and even as i was just washing it out, i felt a huge difference. all i put on after was a leave-in conditioner and i let it air dry and omg. it is so soft and moisturized, it feels so much healthier after just one treatment, and it has this beautiful, healthy glow to it and i genuinely just feel like a new person! my dead ends have been revived and i feel so hopeful that i can restore some health to them with this. i have never had a product do so much in such a small amount of time and i am in love. definitely going to be to using this weekly at the least!

Product: Supercurl 8 Ounce
Title: know what you're reading...
Review: i've only used this once but i really wanted to respond to some other comment about alcohols and sulfates. i did not see a single sulfate in the ingredients list, the alcohol listed is cetaryl alcohol which is a fatty alcohol. not a drying alcohol and is beneficial for the hair. it's always good to read labels but don't assume that all alcohols or sulfates are bad. i use a curly girl method on my hair that cuts out harmful sulfates, silicones, drying alcohols and mineral oils and this stuff is safe and smells amazing. my hair loves it today but it's the first day of use so i can't comment on long term use! i wish i could have simply replied to the other comment but am unable to. :(ingredients list from website:supercurl full ingredients listwater, glycine soja (soybean) oil, glycerin, cocos nucifera (coconut) oil, honey, polymide-1, caprylic/capric triglyceride, butyrospermum parkii (shea butter), fragrance, cetearyl alcohol, ceteareth-20, glyceryl stearate, aloe barbadensis leaf extract, olea europaea (olive) fruit oil, prunus amygdalus dulcis (sweet almond) oil, macadamia ternifolia (macadamia) seed oil, potassium hydroxide, xanthan gum, carbomer, tetrasodium edta, phenoxyethanol, caprylyl glycol, potassium sorbate, caramel.

Product: Supercurl 8 Ounce
Title: non-greasy moisture
Review: this was a nice surprise! i've had this for over a year in a travel/try it kit. i tried the extra butter, but it's too heavy for my hair. i have fine strands, and highly porous afro-textured hair. when i try to refresh with water-based products, my hair frizzes out, so i try not to do it, and usually my products cooperate for 3-4 days. i don't like to rewet my hair to refresh either (but sometimes you have to do it ). it's been really dry over the summer, so i've been experiencing more dryness than usual.anyway, this moisturizer works really well with thirsty curls and curly magic as a refresher. i had to refresh my canopy, and i'm always hesitant to do it, but it worked out! once it dried, my curls/waves were clumped back together, and i had a nice non-greasy, soft, but firm hold.  this product contains glycerine, which can usually make a product sticky also, but no stickiness (that comes when i put the gel over it). there were no fly-aways or that weird frizz one can get when you try to refresh. this will work well until i get ready to shampoo.after those results, i had to order the full size (i always have the 32 oz curly magic gel on hand because it is my favorite). you don't have to use a ton of product. i would say with thirsty curls, you shouldn't use a lot because it tends to suds/bubble, but once you put the curly magic over it, it calms down. seems tricky to use, but it's worth it. don't be heavy handed. step 1) refresh with thirsty curls (not too much), 2) apply supercurl, and 3) curly magic (or gel of choice).
